# Provenance

Figma Designer MCP is maintained by Chammy01. It is originally derived from
[vkhanhqui/figma-mcp-go](https://github.com/vkhanhqui/figma-mcp-go), including work
from [tharuneswarj/figma-mcp](https://github.com/tharuneswarj/figma-mcp).
The original MIT notice is retained without replacing its copyright.

Imported on 2026-10-15 from Figma Designer Standalone commit
`fa2fd109b2ff5b10057582f981211514bf51bc14`, exact vendor tree
`da05aeb87d24cd3f241e249370534ba77fd83fbb`. Upstream lineage remains
`5806e71b8fd4bad97671038a0b010f04df1aaa41`; this upstream commit alone does
not contain every local patch. `ownership-import.json` records all 129 imported
files byte-for-byte, including combine_as_variants, validation/hardening and the
approved conditional operand collector fix. No newer upstream was substituted.

The import commit intentionally preserves the previous product identity. Later
commits identify changes belonging to Chammy01. Figma Designer compatibility
baseline: source app V1.4.2, system 1.2.1, Beta 3 rollback runtime. Stateful
SET_VARIABLE/CONDITIONAL prototype workflows remain HOLD due to native plan limits.
